fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.title: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video.

fields.name: resolution
fields.title: Resolution
fields.description: Resolution of the generated video. Higher resolutions cost more.

fields.name: loop
fields.title: Loop
fields.description: Generate a seamless loop. Only valid for 5s, standard-dynamic-range generations without an end frame.

fields.name: hdr
fields.title: Hdr
fields.description: Generate an HDR-encoded MP4. Requires HDR access on the account and a resolution of 720p or 1080p; not supported with 10s or loop.

fields.name: exr_export
fields.title: Exr Export
fields.description: Also export an EXR file alongside the MP4. Requires hdr=true and HDR access.
